title: A shoreline sketch walk
passage:
COVE SKETCH CLUB | Saturday route card

Start at the pier shelter. The tables there are for anyone who wants to draw without leaving the shelter. If you join the walk, take your own sketchbook with you. We lend drawing boards, but the boards must stay at the shelter because they are too large to carry along the narrow path.

There are two ways to reach the stone arch. The steps offer the clearest view of the fishing boats. The longer path by the sea wall has no steps. Both paths reach the arch, but the view from the sea-wall path is blocked by a fence until the paths meet. If you want to draw a boat on the way rather than wait until the arch, use the steps.

The guide will ask everyone to leave the arch at eleven thirty. If you want to finish a drawing after that, return to the shelter and use one of the tables. We will leave the shelter open until noon as usual; there is no need to walk back with the guide unless you want company.
passageZh:
海灣寫生社｜週六路線卡

請從碼頭遮棚出發。想留在遮棚內作畫的人都可以使用那裡的桌子。若要參加散步，請帶上自己的素描本。我們會出借畫板，但畫板太大，不便帶上狹窄的步道，所以只能留在遮棚使用。

到石拱門有兩條路。走階梯能最清楚看到漁船；沿海堤走的路較長，但沒有階梯。兩條路都通到拱門，不過沿海堤走時，視線會一直被圍欄擋住，直到兩條路會合。如果你想在途中畫船，不想等到拱門再畫，請走階梯。

導覽員會請大家在十一點半離開拱門。想在那之後繼續完成畫作的人，可以回遮棚用桌子。遮棚照常開到中午；除非想找人作伴，否則不必跟導覽員一起走回去。
